title: Fableflight
method: Original code-authored native pixel art; no image generation used in the game
rendering: Nearest-neighbor; integer pixel geometry, scanline circles and polygons, Bresenham lines, cached backgrounds
palette: Forest teal shadows, sage grass, warm straw and parchment; blue moon grove and ochre sun ruins variants

assets.scenes: Three original training environments, layered mountains, distant bridge and tower, woodland workshop, ruins, water, foliage and flowers
assets.archer: Code-articulated idle, draw and release poses, breathing, three cloak tiers and master crown
assets.targets: Straw bundle, oak wheel, crystal bloom, moon bell, sun disc, runestone and articulated stone guardian
assets.growthProps: Bow rack, guild pennant, mechanical bow and arrow crate, mastery trophy
assets.effects: Native pixel arrows, wood chips, damage figures, ring bursts, frost outlines, lightning chains and confetti
assets.icons: Original 24px equipment and elemental rune icons

discardedConcepts: Earlier AI-generated scenery and character concepts are not included or referenced. The user requested native pixel art and authorized a code-only replacement.
